title: Central-Clemson Recreation Center

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: The Central-Clemson Recreation center offers a progressive learn- to- swim program starting with toddlers and ending with adults. Our approach to swimming is to expose children to the water during their younger years when fear of the water is less of a distraction and keep them swimming into their adult years. Our goal is to develop proficient swimmers of all ages, reduce the fear of water and educate on the dangers associated with open waters. Our individual SWIM LESSONS offer the ultimate level of convenience and personalization for you and your child. services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: I’m the Personal Trainer Coordinator and nationally certified personal trainer for the Central Clemson Rec Center. My national training certification is through NESTA and I’m also a certified as a Mind Body Fitness Coach, Lifestyle Weight Management Specialist, and a certified Green Living Coach. My passion for personal training began in college when I started working for a local gym. I focused my education on health science and nutrition earning my BS at Clemson University in 1996. I’m very passionate about helping others find happiness in life and feel good about themselves. I make a point to make each workout fun and always customize my clients workouts for what their needs and goals

blurb: Welcome to the Central-Clemson Recreation Center (CCRC), a family recreation and fitness facility that has been serving the upstate since 1998. CCRC is a joint venture between the Town of Central and the City of Clemson. Our mission is to improve our communities by ensuring they have access to a quality facility with all the amenities needed to stay healthy and have fun.
